summary: PUBLIC SERVICE CO OF NEW HAMPSHIRE (Eversource Energy) filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of $200M aggregate principal amount of 5.35% First Mortgage Bonds, Series X, due 2033. The bonds are issued at 101.696% of par, yielding proceeds of ~$202.1M before expenses. They are fungible with $600M already outstanding under the same series, bringing total to $800M. Interest is paid semi-annually; maturity is October 1, 2033. The bonds are not listed and rank equally with existing first mortgage bonds. Joint book-runners are KeyBanc, PNC, and US Bancorp. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
